title: LUNAX Fire Calendar - harmonized monthly hotspot counts

area.name: Rondônia, Brazil (IBGE boundary in config/area_boundary.geojson; this bbox is the processing box)
area.rule: only detections inside the boundary are counted; outside the boundary is outside the area, not zero fire (DE-1)

source.name: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System)
source.product: FIRMS country yearly summary CSVs, standard processing (SP); FIRMS area API for NOAA-21 (no NOAA-21 country files) and for 2026: standard processing where available, then near real-time (NRT), whose months are flagged provisional in months.csv (DE-4)

grid.area_rule: a cell belongs to a selected area if its centre is inside the rectangle

method.target_scale: VIIRS-equivalent: monthly count of VIIRS 375 m hotspots per cell (DE-2)
method.native_months: from 2012-02: S-NPP to 2018-03, NOAA-20 from 2018-04 (DE-11); NOAA-21 is a check (raw counts only, not used for viirs_eq)
method.estimated_months: 2000-11 to 2012-01: viirs_eq = k(month of year) x MODIS count, with MODIS = Terra + Aqua when both are valid, else Terra (DE-6 option 2, selected by the DE-15 backcast; method/results/validation_metrics.json)
method.uncertainty: viirs_eq_var = model variance x lambda (DE-16). For an area, sum viirs_eq and viirs_eq_var over its cells; the 90 % interval is sum +/- 1.645 x sqrt(summed variance). lambda was calibrated on the monthly totals of the whole demo area; see method/VALIDATION.md

files.monthly_cells.csv: cell_id, year_month, viirs_eq (harmonized), viirs_eq_var (variance, 0 when observed), estimated (1 = converted from MODIS), terra, aqua, snpp, noaa20, noaa21 (raw counts). Empty value = no data, never zero fire. Active cells only: other cells inside the boundary had no detection; cells outside the boundary are outside the area. A cell that crosses the boundary counts only its detections inside it.
files.months.csv: year_month, sat, missing_days, flagged (1 = missing data), provisional (1 = NRT)
files.area.geojson: IBGE boundary of the area (DE-1); draw it and mark everything outside as outside the area
files.municipalities.csv: same columns as monthly_cells.csv with area_id (IBGE municipality code) instead of cell_id: the series of each municipality from the detections inside its boundary, with the same harmonization (DE-24)
files.recurrence.csv: cell_id (0.01°: row = floor((lat+90)/0.01), col = floor((lon+180)/0.01)), years (number of the years in recurrence.years with at least one reference VIIRS detection), detections; cells without detections are not listed, which is not proof of no fire (DE-26)
files.municipalities.geojson: IBGE municipal boundaries (malhas API v3, intermediate quality) with code and name; source URL and retrieval date in each feature (DE-24)

excluded.2023: the reference satellite misses 4 days in July and 1 in September (months.csv)

recurrence.detections: reference VIIRS satellite of DE-11: S-NPP 2012-02 to 2018-03, NOAA-20 from 2018-04

fresh_2026.note: January to October 2026, provisional near real-time data from August

attribution: We acknowledge the use of data and/or imagery from NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) (https://earthdata.nasa.gov/firms), part of NASA's Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for Earth observations (LANCE) (https://earthdata.nasa.gov/lance) and NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
ai_use: AI tools used: Claude and Claude Code (Anthropic), for code, comparison of options for the method decisions, analyses and documentation. Every step is logged in AI_USE.md (https://github.com/jacquesbelmont/lunax-fire-calendar/blob/main/AI_USE.md). No AI-generated images, video or audio. Decisions were made by team members and are recorded in method/DECISIONS.md.
